context: Tests first (they must fail against current code), then the narrowest gate change in corroborate() and overall_status(), then the doc update in the same PR. Add a new blocking verdict constant (e.g. FAILED_STATEMENT) or reuse UNVERIFIABLE with a distinct reason for failed ddl/post_load statements; add a receipt-level dropped section (or per-dropped-intent entries) so the block is visible in the receipt, not just implicit. Keep applied_ledger_hash semantics untouched: it stays a hash over EXECUTED statements only, per ADR-001 (the hash is physical identity; the gate is trust).
description:
From the 2026-07-31 adversarial review of the tuning subsystem (executable proofs, not speculation).

Defect 1 (C1, false applied_verified): corroborate() iterates ledger.executed_statements only (benchbox/core/tuning/introspection.py:481), so a STATEMENT_FAILED entry neither blocks the upgrade nor appears in the receipt. Reachable sequence: Snowflake run tuning two tables; table A's ALTER TABLE ... CLUSTER BY executes and corroborates, table B's fails and is swallowed with a warning (benchbox/platforms/snowflake.py:1743-1744); overall_status derives applied_unverified; _corroborate_applied_ledger (benchbox/platforms/base/adapter.py:1129-1130) upgrades to applied_verified while the same .applied.json carries B's failed entry. Reproduced with a constructed ledger: corroborated=True.

Defect 2 (R1): corroborate() never reads ledger.dropped, so a capability-filtered intent (record_dropped) leaves no receipt entry and a sibling corroborated statement mints applied_verified for a run whose requested tuning was knowingly not applied.

Defect 3 (R3): overall_status (benchbox/core/tuning/applied_ledger.py:228-232) returns applied_unverified when ANY statement executed, including PHASE_SESSION cache hygiene (e.g. Snowflake ALTER SESSION SET USE_CACHED_RESULT, recorded at base/adapter.py:916). A tuned run whose every ddl/post_load statement failed still reports applied_unverified instead of failed. Reproduced.

The trust rule (docs/development/tuning-introspection-receipts.md:17-33) is silent on failed statements and dropped intents; nothing authorizes ignoring them, and the review invariant is 'record LESS, never over-certify'. Semantics to implement: (a) a failed ddl/post_load statement blocks the upgrade and appears in the receipt with a blocking verdict; (b) any dropped intent blocks the upgrade and is surfaced in the receipt payload; (c) session-phase failures stay non-blocking for the upgrade (transient class) but see (d): overall_status returns failed when ddl/post_load statements were attempted and ALL failed, regardless of session-phase successes; a session-SET-only ledger keeps today's applied_unverified semantics.

anti_patterns.dont: Do not derive failure semantics from statement text or mechanism strings
anti_patterns.instead: gate on AppliedStatement.status and phase only
anti_patterns.why: phase and status are the only trustworthy classification inputs the ledger records at execute time

anti_patterns.dont: Do not fix this by filtering failed statements out of the ledger or the .applied.json companion
anti_patterns.instead: keep failed statements recorded and make the gate read them
anti_patterns.why: the companion is the honest record; hiding failures recreates the over-certification one layer down

anti_patterns.dont: Do not make dropped intents a warning-only receipt note
anti_patterns.instead: treat any dropped intent as blocking for the upgrade
anti_patterns.why: known-not-applied tuning is strictly stronger evidence against verification than an unknown statement shape, which already blocks

preserves.behavior: Capture never breaks a run: every record/derive/corroborate path stays non-raising and degrades to debug logs.
Existing receipt payload fields keep their names and shapes; additions only (explorer ingests the receipt verbatim).
Session SET/PRAGMA statements remain transient: they neither earn nor block verification, and a session-only ledger still derives applied_unverified.
applied_ledger_hash stays a hash over ordered EXECUTED statements only (ADR-001 physical identity) - failed statements must NOT enter the hash.
applied_verified remains reachable ONLY via corroborate() from applied_unverified; overall_status never returns it.

verifications.command: uv run -- python -c "from benchbox.core.tuning.applied_ledger import PHASE_DDL, PHASE_POST_LOAD, STATEMENT_FAILED, AppliedTuningLedger; from benchbox.core.tuning.introspection import IntrospectedObject, IntrospectedState, KIND_SORT_KEY, corroborate; led=AppliedTuningLedger(); led.record('CREATE TABLE t (x Int32) ENGINE=MergeTree ORDER BY (a)', PHASE_DDL); led.record('ALTER TABLE u CLUSTER BY (b)', PHASE_POST_LOAD, status=STATEMENT_FAILED, error='boom'); st=IntrospectedState(platform='x', objects=[IntrospectedObject(kind=KIND_SORT_KEY, table='t', columns=('a',))]); assert not corroborate(led, st).corroborated"
verifications.description: Failed ddl/post_load statement blocks the upgrade (post-fix probe)
verifications.expected: exit 0: a failed post_load statement refuses the upgrade even though the sibling statement corroborates

verifications.command: uv run -- python -c "from benchbox.core.tuning.applied_ledger import PHASE_DDL, AppliedTuningLedger; from benchbox.core.tuning.introspection import IntrospectedObject, IntrospectedState, KIND_SORT_KEY, corroborate; led=AppliedTuningLedger(); led.record('CREATE TABLE t (x Int32) ENGINE=MergeTree ORDER BY (a)', PHASE_DDL); led.record_dropped('clustering:orders', 'capability filtered'); st=IntrospectedState(platform='x', objects=[IntrospectedObject(kind=KIND_SORT_KEY, table='t', columns=('a',))]); assert not corroborate(led, st).corroborated"
verifications.description: Dropped intent blocks the upgrade (post-fix probe)
verifications.expected: exit 0: any dropped intent refuses the upgrade

verifications.command: uv run -- python -c "from benchbox.core.tuning.applied_ledger import PHASE_POST_LOAD, PHASE_SESSION, STATEMENT_FAILED, AppliedTuningLedger; led=AppliedTuningLedger(); led.record('SET x=1', PHASE_SESSION); led.record('ALTER TABLE t CLUSTER BY (a)', PHASE_POST_LOAD, status=STATEMENT_FAILED, error='x'); assert led.overall_status(tuning_enabled=True, has_config=True)=='failed'"
verifications.description: All-physical-failed run derives failed, not applied_unverified (post-fix probe)
verifications.expected: exit 0: session-phase successes cannot mask a fully-failed physical tuning

verifications.description: Tuning unit suites and live chDB corroboration tests stay green
verifications.expected: all pass, including the pre-existing verified-upgrade paths

work_units.evidence: Added regression tests in test_applied_ledger.py and test_introspection.py; all three exact post-fix probes exited 1 before implementation (expected red). Pytest invocation was mechanically blocked by active shared lock pid 21954, not bypassed.
work_units.notes: Add regression tests that FAIL against current code: (a) executed+corroborated statement plus STATEMENT_FAILED ddl/post_load statement -> corroborate().corroborated must be False; (b) executed+corroborated statement plus one record_dropped intent -> corroborated must be False; (c) ledger with all ddl/post_load statements failed plus one executed PHASE_SESSION SET -> overall_status must be 'failed'; (d) session-SET-only ledger -> overall_status stays 'applied_unverified'.
work_units.summary: Add failing regression tests: failed ddl/post_load statement, dropped intent, and all-physical-failed + session-SET ledgers must block/demote; session-only ledger stays applied_unverified

work_units.evidence: Implemented status/phase gate over all ledger statements; exact failed-statement probe passes and receipt includes blocking unverifiable entry with failure reason; failed session regression remains transient.
work_units.notes: Block the upgrade on failed ddl/post_load statements: corroborate() must consider ledger.statements (not just executed_statements) for gating, emit a receipt entry with a blocking verdict and the failure reason for each failed ddl/post_load statement, and keep session-phase failures non-blocking.
work_units.summary: corroborate(): failed ddl/post_load statements block the upgrade and get blocking receipt entries; session-phase failures stay non-blocking

work_units.evidence: Receipt now adds dropped intent payload and corroborated is forced false whenever ledger.dropped is non-empty; exact dropped-intent probe passes.
work_units.notes: Block the upgrade on dropped intents: corroborate() reads ledger.dropped, surfaces each dropped intent in the receipt payload, and refuses corroborated=True when any exist.
work_units.summary: corroborate(): any dropped intent blocks the upgrade and is surfaced in the receipt payload

work_units.evidence: overall_status now evaluates ddl/post_load attempts before session successes; exact all-physical-failed probe passes while explicit session-only regression preserves applied_unverified.
work_units.notes: overall_status: return FAILED when >=1 ddl/post_load statement was attempted and all of them failed, regardless of executed session-phase statements; preserve noop/not_applicable branches and the session-only applied_unverified case.
work_units.summary: overall_status: failed when all attempted ddl/post_load statements failed regardless of session successes; preserve noop and session-only semantics

work_units.evidence: Updated receipts trust rule/classification table and ADR-001 status vocabulary for failed physical statements, dropped intents, transient session failures, and all-physical-failed derivation.
work_units.notes: Update the trust rule in docs/development/tuning-introspection-receipts.md (rules 1-3 plus a new explicit failed/dropped clause and classification-table rows) and the ADR-001 status-vocabulary notes so docs and gate agree.
work_units.summary: Update trust rule in receipts design note and ADR-001 vocabulary notes to include failed/dropped blocking
